messages.subject: Rattle 2.5.18 released
parts:
A couple of minor fixes and some fixes to conform with the ongoing
work toward the next release of R itself have been made to Rattle, so
that 2.5.18 now replaces 2.5.16 as the current release from CRAN. It
is currently propagating.

Regards,
Graham
